emma (Finance): Quick heads-up: We're changing invoice cutover timing and how remaining free credits are prorated. Goal: fewer surprise invoices and better daily forecasting. Effective 2026-05-01.

emma (Finance): Summary (short):
- Invoice aggregation moves to daily cutover at 00:00 UTC (previously end-of-month batching).
- Any unused monthly free credits will be prorated to the new window and shown as a line item called `prorated_free_credit`.
- Soft buffer/temporary grace window is being removed; overages will be charged at listed per-unit rates. Startup and partner exceptions will be handled case-by-case with credit holds.

emma (Finance): Example proration calc (for docs):
```
prorated_credit = remaining_days / days_in_cycle * monthly_free_credit
# e.g. remaining_days=10, days_in_cycle=30, monthly_free_credit= $300 => $100 credit
```

raj (Billing): Quick Q — how does this interact with Reserved / Dedicated commits? Will committed capacity still be billed monthly?

emma (Finance): Good Q. Reserved/Dedicated stays on the existing commit billing cadence (monthly/annual) and won't be moved to daily aggregation. The change only affects metered/hosted usage and free-credit proration.

mike (Revenue Ops): Will invoices still show a per-route breakdown? Our AMs need the line items to reconcile.

emma (Finance): Yes — per-route/per-model usage lines are preserved. New items you'll see: `daily_usage_summary` and `prorated_free_credit` line items. Tagging a sample schema in the docs link.
